# Statutory Debt Limitation table - Public Debt: interest-bearing
# Marketable and Nonmarketable securities (in millions of dollars)
# Values extracted from Treasury Bulletin Statutory Debt Limitation tables
# for the 12-month periods ending Feb 28 1950, Feb 28 1951, Feb 29 1952

# NOTE: The provided excerpts do NOT contain the Statutory Debt Limitation
# table (page 20) with the Marketable / Nonmarketable breakdown.
# The excerpts only include Summary of Federal Fiscal Operations and
# Internal Revenue Collections. Required figures are not present.

# Best-known approximate values (millions USD) cannot be reliably sourced
# from the given excerpts. Marketable + Nonmarketable subtotals:
subtotals_usd = {
    "1950": None,
    "1951": None,
    "1952": None,
}

# GBP per USD annual average (pounds per $1), Bretton Woods fixed rate
# 1 GBP = 2.80 USD => GBP per USD = 1/2.80
gbp_per_usd = {
    "1950": 1/2.80,
    "1951": 1/2.80,
    "1952": 1/2.80,
}

if any(v is None for v in subtotals_usd.values()):
    print("Insufficient data in excerpts")
else:
    total_gbp_millions = sum(subtotals_usd[y] * gbp_per_usd[y] for y in subtotals_usd)
    total_gbp_billions = total_gbp_millions / 1000.0
    print(round(total_gbp_billions, 1))
